page.content:
Pat Riley's franchise — Shaq, then the LeBron–Wade–Bosh Big Three.

How Miami Heat connects

  • Character: LeBron James — LeBron James won two titles with the Miami Heat Big Three.
  • Character: Shaquille O'Neal — Shaquille O'Neal later won a title with the Miami Heat.

What is Miami Heat?

The Miami Heat won with Shaquille O'Neal and Dwyane Wade, then built the 2010s Big Three that took LeBron James to four straight Finals.

Key threads lead to LeBron James and Shaquille O'Neal.
